result_semantics.completed: Requested design artifacts were produced and are ready for orchestrator/user review or downstream provider consumption after approval.
result_semantics.partial: Usable design artifacts exist, but named decisions, pages, states, assets, or handoff fields remain missing.
result_semantics.blocked: Required product input, target scope, approved direction, artifact access, permission, or non-waivable design decision is missing or contradictory.
result_semantics.failed: No usable design artifact was produced; include cause and recovery recommendation.

review_policy_notes: Visual approval and source readiness are review_required, not blocked.
Use blocked only for missing/contradictory inputs, missing approved direction for visual_source_creation, or inaccessible required artifacts.
IdeaToDesign may suggest Kanban updates, but PlanToDelivery records canonical gates and downstream unlocks.
